title: "3rd Culture: Unseen Threads" by Kwaku Ofori-Yirenyki Solo Art Exhibit
name: "3rd Culture: Unseen Threads" by Kwaku Ofori-Yirenyki Solo Art Exhibit
description:
ARTfactory Presents “3rd Culture: Unseen Threads”, a Solo Exhibition by Kwaku Ofori-Yirenkyi Exploring Family, Migration, Memory, and Identity


On display: November 7 – December 6, 2026
Opening Reception: Saturday, November 7 | 6:00–8:00 PM
Exhibition programming sponsored by Micron.

Meet the Artist: Print, Create & Connect: Saturday, November 14 | 12:00-5:00 PM

Exhibit Summary
ARTfactory is proud to present “3rd Culture: Unseen Threads” a solo exhibition by artist Kwaku Ofori- Yirenkyi (ABSKU) exploring the intersections of family, migration, memory, and cultural inheritance.

Through painting, fabric, photography, relief, pattern, and abstraction, Ofori-Yirenkyi traces the unseen connections between Ghanaian heritage and contemporary American cultural influences, revealing how identity evolves across generations.

The faceless black figures in his compositions shift attention away from individual likeness and toward presence—gesture, relationships, clothing, symbols, and the ways people carry one another. Kente and Ankara textiles, Adinkra symbols, family imagery, and Ghanaian cultural references exist alongside contemporary abstraction and Western influences.

Across the exhibition, abstract fields of pattern and symbol gradually give way to more specific relationships, places, and family histories. This evolution reflects the artist’s understanding of 3rd Culture: traditional Ghanaian and contemporary Western cultures do not simply exist side by side. Through migration, assimilation, inheritance, and lived experience, they become interwoven into something new.

The unseen threads are what remain connected through that transformation—family, ancestry, memory, values, culture, and belonging. The work asks not only what we inherit, but what we change, what we carry forward, and what we ultimately make our own.

About the Artist
Kwaku Ofori-Yirenkyi, also known as ABSKU, is a Ghanaian American visual artist based in Virginia whose work explores migration, cultural memory, identity, and belonging through the lens of the African diaspora. Born in Ghana and raised in the United States, he draws on Ghanaian textiles, Adinkra symbolism, family narratives, and personal and collective memory. Working primarily in painting and mixed media, ABSKU combines acrylic, oil pastel, fabric, collage, and sculptural materials to create layered works that examine how culture and identity are inherited, carried, and transformed across generations.

For additional information, please visit the ARTfactory or contact the gallery for exhibition details.

title: Norton Showcase - Presented by Norton Network
name: Norton Showcase - Presented by Norton Network
description:
Celebrate Norton, Virginia's native grape, at the Norton Showcase, presented by Norton Network! This exclusive event brings together Virginia's premier Norton producers for a day of exceptional wines, great food, live music, and friendly competition.

Whether you're a longtime Norton fan or discovering the varietal for the first time, you'll enjoy sampling a wide range of Norton wines, meeting the winemakers behind them, and experiencing the passion that makes Virginia's native grape so special.

Grand Norton Tasting Tickets
Your Grand Norton Tasting Ticket includes tasting samples from each of the participating wineries.
**$30 when purchased in advance
*$40 when purchased at the gate on the day of the event

Guests must be 21 years of age or older with a valid government-issued photo ID to purchase or redeem a Grand Norton Tasting Ticket. All IDs will be checked before participating in wine tastings or purchasing wine by the bottle or glass.

Event Highlights
-Grand Norton Tasting featuring Virginia's top Norton producers
-Virginia Norton Judgement wine competition
-Meet the winemakers
-Live music
-Local food trucks and artisan vendors

Please Note
-No pets allowed.
-This is an outdoor event. Please dress for the weather.

Join us for a day of great wine, delicious food, live entertainment, and a celebration of Virginia's signature grape!
